title: Storage ABIEncoderV2 Array
description: solc versions 0.4.7-0.5.9 contain a compiler bug leading to incorrect ABI encoder usage.

title: Arbitrary `from` in transferFrom
description: Detect when msg.sender is not used as from in transferFrom.

title: Modifying storage array by value
description: Detect arrays passed to a function that expects reference to a storage array

title: ABI encodePacked Collision
description: Detect collision due to dynamic type usages in abi.encodePacked

title: Incorrect shift in assembly.
description: Detect if the values in a shift operation are reversed

title: Multiple constructor schemes
description: Detect multiple constructor definitions in the same contract (using new and old schemes).

title: Name reused
description: If a codebase has two contracts the similar names, the compilation artifacts will not contain one of the contracts with the duplicate name.
vulnerable_pattern: Bob's `truffle` codebase has two contracts named `ERC20`. When `truffle compile` runs, only one of the two contracts will generate artifacts in `build/contracts`. As a result, the second contract cannot be analyzed.

title: Protected Variables
description: Detect unprotected variable that are marked protected

title: Public mappings with nested variables
description: Prior to Solidity 0.5, a public mapping with nested structures returned incorrect values.
vulnerable_pattern: Bob interacts with a contract that has a public mapping with nested structures. The values returned by the mapping are incorrect, breaking Bob's usage

title: Right-to-Left-Override character
description: An attacker can manipulate the logic of the contract by using a right-to-left-override character (U+202E).

title: State variable shadowing
description: Detection of state variables shadowed.

title: Suicidal
description: Unprotected call to a function executing selfdestruct/suicide.

title: Uninitialized state variables
description: Uninitialized state variables.

title: Uninitialized storage variables
description: An uninitialized storage variable will act as a reference to the first state variable, and can override a critical variable.

title: Unprotected upgradeable contract
description: Detects logic contract that can be destructed.

title: Arbitrary `from` in transferFrom used with permit
description: Detect when msg.sender is not used as from in transferFrom and permit is used.

title: Functions that send Ether to arbitrary destinations
description: Unprotected call to a function sending Ether to an arbitrary address.

title: Array Length Assignment
description: Detects the direct assignment of an array's length.

title: Controlled Delegatecall
description: Delegatecall or callcode to an address controlled by the user.

title: Payable functions using `delegatecall` inside a loop
description: Detect the use of delegatecall inside a loop in a payable function.

title: Incorrect exponentiation
description: Detect use of bitwise xor ^ instead of exponential **

title: Incorrect return in assembly
description: Detect if return in an assembly block halts unexpectedly the execution.

title: `msg.value` inside a loop
description: Detect the use of msg.value inside a loop.

title: Reentrancy vulnerabilities
description: Detects reentrancy vulnerabilities where a balance is saved (e.g., balanceOf) before an external call, and the same balance is checked again after the call. An attacker could manipulate the balance during the reentrant call, causing the post-call check to use an outdated value.

title: Reentrancy vulnerabilities
description: Detection of the reentrancy bug. Do not report reentrancies that don't involve Ether (see reentrancy-no-eth)

title: Return instead of leave in assembly
description: Detect if a return is used where a leave should be used.

title: Storage Signed Integer Array
description: solc versions 0.4.7-0.5.9 contain a compiler bug leading to incorrect values in signed integer arrays.

title: Unchecked transfer
description: The return value of an external transfer/transferFrom call is not checked

title: Weak PRNG
description: Weak PRNG due to a modulo on block.timestamp, now or blockhash. These can be influenced by miners to some extent so they should be avoided.

title: Domain separator collision
description: An ERC20 token has a function whose signature collides with EIP-2612's DOMAIN_SEPARATOR(), causing unanticipated behavior for contracts using permit functionality.

title: Dangerous enum conversion
description: Detect out-of-range enum conversion (solc < 0.4.5).

title: Incorrect erc20 interface
description: Incorrect return values for ERC20 functions. A contract compiled with Solidity > 0.4.22 interacting with these functions will fail to execute them, as the return value is missing.

title: Incorrect erc721 interface
description: Incorrect return values for ERC721 functions. A contract compiled with solidity > 0.4.22 interacting with these functions will fail to execute them, as the return value is missing.

title: Dangerous strict equalities
description: Use of strict equalities that can be easily manipulated by an attacker.

title: Contracts that lock Ether
description: Contract with a payable function, but without a withdrawal capacity.

title: Deletion on mapping containing a structure
description: A deletion in a structure containing a mapping will not delete the mapping (see the Solidity documentation). The remaining data may be used to compromise the contract.

title: Pyth deprecated functions
description: Detect when a Pyth deprecated function is used

title: Pyth unchecked confidence level
description: Detect when the confidence level of a Pyth price is not checked

title: Pyth unchecked publishTime
description: Detect when the publishTime of a Pyth price is not checked

title: State variable shadowing from abstract contracts
description: Detection of state variables shadowed from abstract contracts.

title: Tautological compare
description: A variable compared to itself is probably an error as it will always return true for ==, >=, <= and always false for <, > and !=.

title: Tautology or contradiction
description: Detects expressions that are tautologies or contradictions.

title: Write after write
description: Detects variables that are written but never read and written again.

title: Misuse of a Boolean constant
description: Detects the misuse of a Boolean constant.

title: Chronicle unchecked price
description: Chronicle oracle is used and the price returned is not checked to be valid. For more information https://docs.chroniclelabs.org/Resources/FAQ/Oracles#how-do-i-check-if-an-oracle-becomes-inactive-gets-deprecated.

title: Constant functions using assembly code
description: Functions declared as constant/pure/view using assembly code. constant/pure/view was not enforced prior to Solidity 0.5. Starting from Solidity 0.5, a call to a constant/pure/view function uses the STATICCALL opcode, which reverts in case of state modification. As a result, a call to an incorrectly labeled function may trap a contract compiled with Solidity 0.5.

title: Constant functions changing the state
description: Functions declared as constant/pure/view change the state. constant/pure/view was not enforced prior to Solidity 0.5. Starting from Solidity 0.5, a call to a constant/pure/view function uses the STATICCALL opcode, which reverts in case of state modification. As a result, a call to an incorrectly labeled function may trap a contract compiled with Solidity 0.5.

title: Divide before multiply
description: Solidity's integer division truncates. Thus, performing division before multiplication can lead to precision loss.

title: Gelato unprotected randomness
description: Detect calls to _requestRandomness within an unprotected function.

title: Out-of-order retryable transactions
description: Out-of-order retryable transactions

title: Reentrancy vulnerabilities
description: Detection of the reentrancy bug. Do not report reentrancies that involve Ether (see reentrancy-eth).

title: Reused base constructors
description: Detects if the same base constructor is called with arguments from two different locations in the same inheritance hierarchy.

title: Dangerous usage of `tx.origin`
description: tx.origin-based protection can be abused by a malicious contract if a legitimate user interacts with the malicious contract.

title: Unchecked low-level calls
description: The return value of a low-level call is not checked.

title: Unchecked Send
description: The return value of a send is not checked.

title: Uninitialized local variables
description: Uninitialized local variables.

title: Unused return
description: The return value of an external call is not stored in a local or state variable.

title: Chainlink Feed Registry usage
description: Detect when Chainlink Feed Registry is used. At the moment is only available on Ethereum Mainnet.

title: Incorrect modifier
description: If a modifier does not execute _ or revert, the execution of the function will return the default value, which can be misleading for the caller.

title: Optimism deprecated predeploy or function
description: Detect when deprecated Optimism predeploy or function is used.

title: Built-in Symbol Shadowing
description: Detection of shadowing built-in symbols using local variables, state variables, functions, modifiers, or events.

title: Local variable shadowing
description: Detection of shadowing using local variables.

title: Uninitialized function pointers in constructors
description: solc versions 0.4.5-0.4.26 and 0.5.0-0.5.8 contain a compiler bug leading to unexpected behavior when calling uninitialized function pointers in constructors.

title: Pre-declaration usage of local variables
description: Detects the possible usage of a variable before the declaration is stepped over (either because it is later declared, or declared in another scope).

title: Void constructor
description: Detect the call to a constructor that is not implemented

title: Calls inside a loop
description: Calls inside a loop might lead to a denial-of-service attack.

title: Missing events access control
description: Detect missing events for critical access control parameters

title: Missing events arithmetic
description: Detect missing events for critical arithmetic parameters.

title: Dangerous unary expressions
description: Unary expressions such as x=+1 probably typos.
vulnerable_pattern: ```Solidity contract Bug{ uint public counter; function increase() public returns(uint){ counter=+1; return counter; } } ``` `increase()` uses `=+` instead of `+=`, so `counter` will never exceed 1.

title: Missing zero address validation
description: Detect missing zero address validation.

title: Reentrancy vulnerabilities
description: Detection of the reentrancy bug. Only report reentrancy that acts as a double call (see reentrancy-eth, reentrancy-no-eth).

title: Reentrancy vulnerabilities
description: Detects reentrancies that allow manipulation of the order or value of events.

title: Return Bomb
description: A low level callee may consume all callers gas unexpectedly.

title: Block timestamp
description: Dangerous usage of block.timestamp. block.timestamp can be manipulated by miners.
vulnerable_pattern: "Bob's contract relies on `block.timestamp` for its randomness. Eve is a miner and manipulates `block.timestamp` to exploit Bob's contract.

title: Assembly usage
description: The use of assembly is error-prone and should be avoided.

title: Assert state change
description: Incorrect use of assert(). See Solidity best practices.

title: Boolean equality
description: Detects the comparison to boolean constants.

title: Cyclomatic complexity
description: Detects functions with high (> 11) cyclomatic complexity.

title: Deprecated standards
description: Detect the usage of deprecated standards.

title: Unindexed ERC20 event parameters
description: Detects whether events defined by the ERC20 specification that should have some parameters as indexed are missing the indexed keyword.

title: Function Initializing State
description: Detects the immediate initialization of state variables through function calls that are not pure/constant, or that use non-constant state variable.

title: Incorrect usage of using-for statement
description: In Solidity, it is possible to use libraries for certain types, by the using-for statement (using <library> for <type>). However, the Solidity compiler doesn't check whether a given library has at least one function matching a given type. If it doesn't, such a statement has no effect and may be confusing.

title: Low-level calls
description: The use of low-level calls is error-prone. Low-level calls do not check for code existence or call success.

title: Missing inheritance
description: Detect missing inheritance.

title: Conformance to Solidity naming conventions
description: Solidity defines a naming convention that should be followed.

title: Different pragma directives are used
description: Detect whether different Solidity versions are used.

title: Redundant Statements
description: Detect the usage of redundant statements that have no effect.

title: Incorrect versions of Solidity
description: solc frequently releases new compiler versions. Using an old version prevents access to new Solidity security checks. We also recommend avoiding complex pragma statement.

title: Unimplemented functions
description: Detect functions that are not implemented on derived-most contracts.

title: Unindexed event address parameters
description: Detects events that have address-type parameters but no indexed parameters. Indexing event parameters enables efficient off-chain filtering.

title: Unused state variable
description: Unused state variable.

title: Costly operations inside a loop
description: Costly operations inside a loop might waste gas, so optimizations are justified.

title: Dead-code
description: Functions that are not used.

title: Reentrancy vulnerabilities
description: Detection of the reentrancy bug. Only report reentrancy that is based on transfer or send.

title: Too many digits
description: Literals with many digits are difficult to read and review. Use scientific notation or suffixes to make the code more readable.

title: Cache array length
description: Detects for loops that use length member of some storage array in their loop condition and don't modify it.

title: State variables that could be declared constant
description: State variables that are not updated following deployment should be declared constant to save gas.

title: Public function that could be declared external
description: public functions that are never called by the contract should be declared external, and its immutable parameters should be located in calldata to save gas.

title: State variables that could be declared immutable
description: State variables that are not updated following deployment should be declared immutable to save gas.

title: Public variable read in external context
description: The contract reads its own variable using this, adding overhead of an unnecessary STATICCALL.

title: Delegate Call To Untrusted Contract
description: Detects delegatecall/callcode invocations to a contract address that is not a fixed, trusted address.

title: Dependence on Predictable Variables
description: Detects use of predictable state such as block.timestamp or blockhash as a source of randomness or as a critical control condition.

title: Ether Thief
description: Detects execution paths in which an attacker can withdraw Ether they did not deposit.

title: Exceptions
description: Detects reachable exception states (failing assertions and other error states).

title: External Calls
description: Detects external calls to user-supplied addresses, a prerequisite of reentrancy and similar issues.

title: Integer
description: Detects integer overflow and underflow conditions.

title: Multiple Sends
description: Detects multiple external sends of Ether in a single transaction, a pattern that can trigger out-of-gas DoS.

title: Suicide
description: Detects reachable selfdestruct instructions callable by unauthorized users.

title: State Change External Calls
description: Detects state changes that occur after an external call has been made (reentrancy precondition).

title: Unchecked Retval
description: Detects unchecked return values from external calls.

title: User Supplied Assertion
description: Detects user-controlled data reaching an assert() statement, which should only encode invariants.

title: Arbitrary Storage Write
description: Detects writes to storage locations computed from user-controlled data.

title: Arbitrary Jump
description: Detects use of a user-controlled value as a jump destination in inline assembly.

title: Transaction Order Dependence
description: Detects state that can be front-run because its outcome depends on transaction ordering.

title: Requirement Violation
description: Detects reachable violations of require() conditions given attacker-controlled input.

title: Unexpected Ether Balance
description: Detects logic that assumes a specific Ether balance which can be forced by an attacker (e.g. via selfdestruct).

title: Assertions
description: Formally verifies that every reachable assert() statement cannot fail for any input.

title: Arithmetic Underflow
description: Formally verifies that unsigned/checked arithmetic cannot underflow (disabled by default for Solidity >=0.8.7, since the compiler already reverts on underflow).

title: Arithmetic Overflow
description: Formally verifies that arithmetic cannot overflow (disabled by default for Solidity >=0.8.7, since the compiler already reverts on overflow).

title: Division by Zero
description: Formally verifies that no division or modulo operation can be reached with a zero divisor.

title: Trivial Conditions and Unreachable Code
description: Identifies conditions that are always true/false and code that can never be reached, which typically indicates a logic error.

title: Empty Array Pop Operations
description: Formally verifies that pop() is never called on an array with zero elements.

title: Out of Bounds Index Access
description: Formally verifies that array, fixed bytes, and calldata array accesses stay within bounds.

title: Insufficient Funds for Transfer
description: Formally verifies that a contract has sufficient balance whenever it attempts to transfer Ether.

title: TODAmount
description: Transaction-ordering dependence in the amount transferred.

title: TODReceiver
description: Transaction-ordering dependence in the receiver of a transfer.

title: TODTransfer
description: Transaction-ordering dependence in whether a transfer happens at all.

title: UnrestrictedWrite
description: A storage write can be controlled by an unrestricted, attacker-influenced index or value.

title: RightToLeftOverride
description: Source code contains a right-to-left-override Unicode control character.

title: ShadowedStateVariable
description: A state variable shadows another state or abstract-contract variable.

title: UnrestrictedSelfdestruct
description: selfdestruct is reachable by an unauthorized caller.

title: UninitializedStateVariable
description: A state variable is read before being initialized.

title: UninitializedStorage
description: An uninitialized storage pointer is used, risking unintended storage aliasing.

title: UnrestrictedDelegateCall
description: delegatecall target or data is controlled by an unauthorized caller.

title: DAO
description: A reentrant call can be used to drain Ether (classic 'DAO' pattern).

title: ERC20Interface
description: The contract's ERC20 interface deviates from the standard.

title: ERC721Interface
description: The contract's ERC721 interface deviates from the standard.

title: IncorrectEquality
description: A strict equality check is used on a value (e.g. balance) that an attacker can manipulate.

title: LockedEther
description: The contract can receive Ether but has no path that allows it to be withdrawn.

title: ReentrancyNoETH
description: A reentrant call is possible without directly involving an Ether transfer.

title: TxOrigin
description: tx.origin is used for an authorization check.

title: UnhandledException
description: The return value of a low-level call is not checked.

title: UnrestrictedEtherFlow
description: An unrestricted party can trigger an outgoing Ether transfer.

title: UninitializedLocal
description: A local variable is used before assignment.

title: UnusedReturn
description: The return value of an external call is not used.

title: ShadowedBuiltin
description: An identifier shadows a Solidity built-in symbol.

title: ShadowedLocalVariable
description: A local variable shadows an outer-scope variable.

title: CallToDefaultConstructor
description: A call is made to a contract constructor that has no logic, which may indicate a mistake.

title: CallInLoop
description: An external call is made inside a loop.

title: ReentrancyBenign
description: A reentrant call exists but does not appear directly exploitable given surrounding checks.

title: Timestamp
description: block.timestamp is used in a way that miners/validators can influence within tolerance.

title: AssemblyUsage
description: Inline assembly is used, bypassing some Solidity-level safety checks.

title: ERC20Indexed
description: ERC20 event parameters are not indexed as recommended by the standard.

title: LowLevelCalls
description: A low-level call is used, bypassing type/existence checks.

title: NamingConvention
description: Identifiers do not follow Solidity naming conventions.

title: SolcVersion
description: An outdated or floating compiler version pragma is used.

title: UnusedStateVariable
description: A state variable is declared but never read or written.

title: TooManyDigits
description: A numeric literal has an unusually large number of digits, risking a typo.

title: ConstableStates
description: A state variable could be declared constant.

title: ExternalFunctions
description: A public function that is never called internally could be declared external.

title: StateVariablesDefaultVisibility
description: A state variable does not have an explicit visibility specifier.

title: SOLIDITY_ADDRESS_HARDCODED
description: An Ethereum address is hardcoded into the contract source.

title: SOLIDITY_ARRAY_LENGTH_MANIPULATION
description: Array length is manipulated directly, which can corrupt array storage layout.

title: SOLIDITY_BALANCE_EQUALITY
description: A strict equality check is performed against a contract's Ether balance.

title: SOLIDITY_BYTE_ARRAY_INSTEAD_BYTES
description: A byte array is used where the more efficient 'bytes' type would be appropriate.

title: SOLIDITY_CONSTRUCTOR_RETURN
description: A constructor contains a return statement with a value, which has no effect.

title: SOLIDITY_CALL_WITHOUT_DATA
description: A low-level call is made without any calldata, which can unexpectedly trigger a fallback function.

title: SOLIDITY_DELETE_ON_DYNAMIC_ARRAYS
description: delete is used on a dynamic array element without shifting subsequent elements, leaving a gap.

title: SOLIDITY_DEPRECATED_CONSTRUCTIONS
description: A deprecated Solidity construct is used.

title: SOLIDITY_DIV_MUL
description: A division is performed before a multiplication, causing avoidable precision loss.

title: SOLIDITY_DO_WHILE_CONTINUE
description: A continue statement is used inside a do-while loop, which can produce unexpected control flow.

title: SOLIDITY_DOS_WITH_THROW
description: A single failing external call inside a loop or batch operation can revert the whole transaction, enabling denial of service.

title: SOLIDITY_ERC20_APPROVE
description: The ERC20 approve function is implemented in a way susceptible to the front-running double-spend race condition.

title: SOLIDITY_ERC20_FUNCTIONS_ALWAYS_RETURN_FALSE
description: An ERC20 function is implemented so that it always returns false instead of reverting or succeeding correctly.

title: SOLIDITY_ERC20_INDEXED
description: ERC20 Transfer/Approval event parameters are not indexed.

title: SOLIDITY_ERC20_TRANSFER_SHOULD_THROW
description: An ERC20 transfer function does not revert on failure as the standard expects.

title: SOLIDITY_EXACT_TIME
description: Contract logic depends on an exact block timestamp value rather than a tolerant range.

title: SOLIDITY_EXTRA_GAS_IN_LOOPS
description: A loop performs unnecessary storage operations that waste gas on every iteration.

title: SOLIDITY_FUNCTION_RETURNS_TYPE_AND_NO_RETURN
description: A function declares a return type but has a code path that does not return a value.

title: SOLIDITY_GAS_LIMIT_IN_LOOPS
description: A loop iterates over an unbounded collection, risking exceeding the block gas limit.

title: SOLIDITY_INCORRECT_BLOCKHASH
description: blockhash is used incorrectly, such as for a block number outside the 256-block window, which returns zero.

title: SOLIDITY_LOCKED_MONEY
description: The contract can receive Ether but has no function that allows it to be withdrawn.

title: SOLIDITY_MSGVALUE_EQUALS_ZERO
description: A payable function does not check that msg.value is nonzero where a nonzero payment is expected.

title: SOLIDITY_OVERPOWERED_ROLE
description: A privileged role is granted excessive power over contract funds or logic.

title: SOLIDITY_PRAGMAS_VERSION
description: The pragma statement does not pin a specific compiler version.

title: SOLIDITY_PRIVATE_MODIFIER_DOES_NOT_HIDE_DATA
description: A 'private' state variable is assumed to be confidential, but all on-chain state is publicly readable.

title: SOLIDITY_REDUNDANT_FALLBACK_REJECT
description: A fallback function unnecessarily reverts, which may block legitimate Ether transfers.

title: SOLIDITY_REVERT_REQUIRE
description: require()/revert() is used inconsistently or suboptimally relative to the other.

title: SOLIDITY_REWRITE_ON_ASSEMBLY_CALL
description: Inline assembly performs a call in a way that bypasses standard Solidity safety checks.

title: SOLIDITY_SAFEMATH
description: Arithmetic is performed without SafeMath or compiler-level overflow checks.

title: SOLIDITY_SEND
description: The low-level send() function is used instead of the safer transfer()/call() pattern for Ether transfer.

title: SOLIDITY_SHOULD_NOT_BE_PURE
description: A function is declared pure but its logic suggests it should read state.

title: SOLIDITY_SHOULD_NOT_BE_VIEW
description: A function is declared view but its logic suggests it should modify state.

title: SOLIDITY_SHOULD_RETURN_STRUCT
description: A function returns multiple loose values that would be clearer as a struct.

title: SOLIDITY_TRANSFER_IN_LOOP
description: An Ether transfer is performed inside a loop, risking gas exhaustion or a single failure blocking all transfers.

title: SOLIDITY_TX_ORIGIN
description: tx.origin is used for an authorization check.

title: SOLIDITY_UINT_CANT_BE_NEGATIVE
description: An unsigned integer is checked against a negative value, a condition that can never be true.

title: SOLIDITY_UNCHECKED_CALL
description: The return value of a low-level call is not checked.

title: SOLIDITY_UNUSED_FUNCTION_SHOULD_BE_EXTERNAL
description: A public function that is never called internally could be declared external to save gas.

title: SOLIDITY_UPGRADE_TO_050
description: Code uses constructs deprecated ahead of the Solidity 0.5.0 breaking-change release.

title: SOLIDITY_USING_INLINE_ASSEMBLY
description: Inline assembly is used, bypassing some Solidity-level safety guarantees.

title: SOLIDITY_VAR
description: The deprecated 'var' keyword is used instead of an explicit type.

title: SOLIDITY_VAR_IN_LOOP_FOR
description: A loop counter is declared with 'var', which can infer an unintended, too-small integer type.

title: SOLIDITY_VISIBILITY
description: A function or state variable does not have an explicit visibility specifier.

title: SOLIDITY_WRONG_SIGNATURE
description: A function signature does not match the one intended, such as a mismatched fallback or interface signature.

title: compound-borrowfresh-reentrancy
description: Compound-fork 'borrowFresh' reentrancy pattern.
real_world_targets: Compound, Ola Finance, Hundred Finance, Agave

title: erc20-public-transfer
description: A token transfer-related function is left publicly callable in a way that lets a caller move funds without authorization.

title: erc677-reentrancy
description: Reentrancy via the ERC677 transferAndCall callback hook.

title: erc777-reentrancy
description: Reentrancy via the ERC777 tokensReceived/tokensToSend callback hooks.

title: erc721-reentrancy
description: Reentrancy via the ERC721 onERC721Received callback hook during a safe transfer.

title: keeper-network-oracle-manipulation
description: A price feed sourced from a Keeper-Network-style on-chain oracle can be manipulated.

title: basic-oracle-manipulation
description: A spot price read directly from an AMM pool is used without manipulation resistance.

title: proxy-storage-collision
description: A proxy contract's storage layout collides with its implementation's, corrupting state on delegatecall.

title: balancer-readonly-reentrancy-getrate
description: Balancer's getRate() can be read mid-transaction during a reentrant callback, returning a manipulated value.

title: balancer-readonly-reentrancy-getpooltokens
description: Balancer's getPoolTokens() can be read mid-transaction during a reentrant callback, returning a manipulated value.

title: curve-readonly-reentrancy
description: A Curve pool's view functions can be read mid-transaction during a reentrant callback, returning stale/manipulated state.

title: olympus-dao-staking-incorrect-call-order
description: Incorrect ordering of staking/rebase calls in an OlympusDAO-style contract.
real_world_targets: OlympusDAO, FloorDAO, Heavens Gate, Jump Farm, QuantumWN

title: compound-precision-loss
description: A Compound-fork interest-rate/exchange-rate calculation loses precision in a way an attacker can exploit.
real_world_targets: Hundred Finance, Midas Finance, Onyx Protocol

title: thirdweb-vulnerability
description: A vulnerable pattern inherited from a thirdweb contract template.

title: uniswap-v4-callback-not-protected
description: A Uniswap v4 pool-manager callback is not restricted to the pool manager, allowing an attacker to invoke it directly.

title: User-defined boolean invariants (echidna_ prefixed)
description: Fuzzes randomized call sequences against Solidity functions named echidna_* that take no arguments and return bool; a finding is any sequence that drives the invariant to false. Echidna has no fixed bug catalog of its own; the properties checked are written by the auditor.

title: Solidity assert()/Foundry assertX() failures
description: Fuzzes call sequences to find any that trigger a failing assert() or a Foundry-style assertTrue/assertEq/etc. helper.

title: Foundry-style unit, fuzz and stateful invariant tests
description: Runs Foundry-convention test/testFail-prefixed unit and fuzz tests and invariant/statefulFuzz-prefixed stateful invariants under Echidna's fuzzing engine.

title: Maximization of an int256-returning function
description: Searches for a call sequence that maximizes the return value of an echidna_*-prefixed function returning int256, used to bound worst-case economic outcomes rather than to find a pass/fail bug.

title: env-instr
description: Use of potentially unsafe/manipulable environmental instructions (e.g. block/timestamp-derived values).

title: suicidal
description: Reachable SELFDESTRUCT instruction.

title: ext-call-leak
description: Reachable external call or Ether leak to the caller or to an arbitrary, symbolically-controlled address.

title: invalid
description: Reachable INVALID instruction, signalling an exceptional/aborted execution path.

title: reentrancy
description: Reentrancy bug (simple detector: re-entry into a function that has already sent value).

title: reentrancy-adv
description: Reentrancy bug (advanced detector tracking state written before and read after an external call).

title: overflow
description: Potential integer overflow or underflow on ADD/SUB instructions.

title: unused-return
description: Unused return value from an internal (message) transaction.

title: delegatecall
description: DELEGATECALL to a symbolically-controlled address and/or with a symbolically-controlled function selector.

title: uninitialized-memory
description: Use of uninitialized memory.

title: uninitialized-storage
description: Use of uninitialized storage.

title: race-condition
description: Possible transaction-order-dependence: a state variable's value at one point diverges depending on the ordering of pending transactions.

title: lockdrop
description: A strict equality comparison uses a manipulable Ether balance operand.

title: User-written Certora Verification Language (CVL) rules and invariants
description: Formally verifies user-authored rules and invariants, written in CVL, against a contract's bytecode using SMT solvers; it has no fixed catalog of bugs of its own, only the properties the auditor or development team chooses to specify and prove.
